text:
ashok: FYI seeing a spike in token-stream stalls from one GPU pool after a ~3s window of heavy reordering/jitter around 12:30 UTC. Streaming RPCs hit deadline or emit partial responses.
riley: ugh. which pool/region?
ashok: west-coast batch pool (gpupool-usw2b). Affected hosts concentrated in rack r12-r14. Usually <0.1% reorder; during the window it spiked to ~6% for ~90s.
ashok: pasted a pcap sample and a quick ethtool output below
ashok: ```
# tcptrace snippet (flow id masked)
reorder_count=72 total_pkts=1200 window=90s
# ethtool -k eno3
rx-checksumming: on
tx-checksumming: on
scatter-gather: on
sg: on
gso: on
lro: off
``` 
carmen: Any recent config pushes or firmware rollouts to the r12-r14 TORs?
infra-bot: deploy: switch-firmware-2026-03-14 applied to tor-r12 at 11:58 UTC, tor-r13 at 12:02 UTC
riley: looks like the firmware push lines up. telemetry shows microbursts on egress queues right after the push. Could be driver/firmware interaction with GSO/GRO.
sam: Are flows RDMA or plain TCP for streaming tokens?
ashok: Streaming is gRPC over TCP; but some infra-level RDMA tunnels used for bulk model fetches on the same hosts (not same traffic class). Could be oversubscription causing queue preemption.
carmen: Quick mitigation: disable GSO on affected hosts to force smaller segments and reduce reorder amplification? We'll test on a canary host.
riley: +1. Also try pinning streaming processes to different NIC NUMA or move evictions to another rack to reduce competing traffic.
ashok: Canaries started: host gpupool-usw2b-r12-h07 set gso off at 12:46 UTC. Observability: reorder dropped to 0.6% and token stalls stopped within 45s.
infra-bot: alert suppressed for gpupool-usw2b-r12-h07 at 12:50 UTC (manual suppress by riley)
sam: Good result. For longer term we should roll back the firmware to previous version for r12/r13 and open a ticket with vendor. Also add an SLO rule to flag >1% reordering in 1m windows.
carmen: Filing ticket now. Also adding a fallback in runtime: if per-flow reorder crosses threshold, temporarily disable TSO/GSO on that host and route streaming to alternate racks.
ashok: Action items: 1) Revert firmware on tor-r12 & r13 (ashok/riley). 2) Add reorder SLO + alert (sam). 3) Implement runtime fallback (carmen). 4) Postmortem if vendor confirms firmware bug (all).
riley: I'll coordinate revert window with netops and schedule a short maintenance for 13:00-13:20 UTC.
ashok: thanks. saving pcap and state to /var/spool/ir/1845000427-pcap for postmortem. Will update after revert.
sam: Nice work catching the pattern quickly :thumbsup:
ashok: :+1: will update thread after next hour checks.
